text: Single WebSocket API handles full duplex audio in and out for voice agents
quote: Deepgram's Voice Agent API collapses that stack into a single, unified API. You open one WebSocket connection, send audio in, and receive audio out.

text: Function calling lets the agent perform tasks/actions during a live call
quote: In the context of Deepgram Voice Agents, function calling enables your agent to perform tasks during a live conversation.

text: Multi-agent architecture lets specialized agents hand off based on context or intent
quote: Multi-Agent Architecture: orchestrate multiple specialized agents that hand off based on context, intent, or domain.

text: Reusable agent configurations can be saved via the API and referenced later by UUID
quote: Reusable Agent Configurations allow you to define and persist the agent block of your Settings message using the Deepgram API. Once created, you receive a UUID that can be passed in place of the full agent object

text: Telephony support connects voice agents to phone networks for inbound and outbound calls
quote: Telephony: connect voice agents to phone networks for inbound and outbound calls.

text: Browser Agent SDK adds voice AI to web apps via composable packages
quote: Browser Agent SDK: add voice AI to any web application via four composable packages.

text: System prompts can be written to shape agent behavior during live calls
quote: Prompting: write system prompts that shape live-call behavior.

text: Barge-in support lets callers interrupt and stop the agent's speech instantly
quote: That includes barge-in, the ability to talk over the agent and have it stop instantly.

text: Supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Google, Groq, and NVIDIA
quote: Supported LLM providers | Parameter | open_ai | anthropic | aws_bedrock | google | groq | nvidia

text: Multilingual agents let you pick separate STT and TTS models for the user's and agent's languages
quote: A multilingual voice agent has two model decisions: which STT model transcribes the user, and which TTS model speaks the agent.

text: Mid-call message injection makes the agent speak a specific line on demand
quote: Inject agent message | Mid-call | InjectAgentMessage | Makes the agent speak a specific line

text: Official dg CLI can transcribe files, stream live audio, synthesize speech, analyze text, and manage the account
quote: The dg CLI lets you transcribe files, stream live audio, synthesize speech, analyze text, and manage your Deepgram account from the terminal.

text: dg CLI ships a built-in MCP server giving AI coding tools direct access to Deepgram APIs
quote: The dg CLI includes a built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that gives AI coding tools direct access to Deepgram APIs.

text: Temporary tokens provide secure, short-lived credentials for real-time applications
quote: Unlike traditional API keys, temporary tokens are ideal for real-time applications requiring secure, temporary access to Deepgram's services.

text: Per-request opt-out flag prevents data from being retained/used for model improvement
quote: Opt out per request with mip_opt_out=true. Opted-out requests are not retained

text: EU-specific API endpoint allows data processing within the European Union
quote: For customers requiring data processing within the European Union, Deepgram provides an EU-specific endpoint at api.eu.deepgram.com.

text: A/B testing of voices or prompts lets you compare configurations and pick a winner without redeploying
quote: A/B testing voices or prompts — Run two configurations in parallel and measure conversion, CSAT, or containment rate to pick a winner—no code deploy required.

text: Twilio call audio can be bridged over a single WebSocket into the Voice Agent API for the whole conversation
quote: Twilio streams the call audio to your server, and your server bridges that audio to the Deepgram Voice Agent API, a single WebSocket that runs the entire conversation
